locators.row: Merged ListTile node: [...document.querySelectorAll('flt-semantics[role="button"]')].find(e => e.getAttribute('aria-label')?.includes(name)) — click via el.click() (fallback: mouse at rect center).
locators.textfield: document.querySelector('flt-semantics[role="textbox"][aria-label="<fieldName>"] input') — labelText becomes aria-label; type via real CDP keystrokes, never el.value=.
locators.button: [...document.querySelectorAll('flt-semantics[role="button"]')].find(e => (e.getAttribute('aria-label')||'').trim() === label) el.click(); assert not aria-disabled before submit.

assertions.list-visible: row-count === expected seed rows; pre-flight assert flt-semantics-host exists (ensureSemantics is on).
assertions.fill-form: after typing each field, input.value === typed text; Submit has no aria-disabled once valid.
assertions.submit: URL pathname ends /<entity>/<id> and no loading spinner node remains.
assertions.detail-shows-created: some flt-semantics aria-label contains the created title + its field values.
assertions.update: re-type one field to v2, submit, assert detail aria-label contains v2.
assertions.delete: click Delete, assert its row node is removed from DOM.
assertions.list-empty: row-count === 0 AND EmptyState text ('No items'/'No data') present.

bestPractices: anti-throttle headless: launch with --disable-background-timer-throttling --disable-backgrounding-occluded-windows --disable-renderer-backgrounding; use CDP over puppeteer-core (no bundled Chromium needed).
pumpAndSettle-equivalent: waitForFunction polling a snapshot of flt-semantics-host's innerText+aria-labels until 2 consecutive samples (≈500ms apart) are identical; never fixed sleeps.
aria-label requirement: locators live solely on semantics; add a pre-check that every target node has a non-empty aria-label (the generator's Semantics/ensureSemantics contract), or fail fast.
screenshot per step: page.screenshot({path}) right after each assertion — pixel evidence pairs with the aria assertions.
pitfalls: canvas vs semantics: text lives in aria-label ATTRIBUTES, not innerText — innerText is often empty/partial; always read getAttribute('aria-label'). Missing ensureSemantics() = blank <flt-glass-pane> and zero nodes.
flt-glass-pane timing: the boot glass pane swallows early synthetic clicks; wait until the target semantics node exists AND is visible, then el.click() on the node (not canvas coordinates).

text selection: Flutter web keeps a real <input>; writing el.value + dispatching input does not update Flutter. Focus the input, Ctrl/Cmd+A then Input.dispatchKeyEvent Backspace to clear, and type via Input.insertText/Input.dispatchKeyEvent — empty insertText('') fires nothing.
